First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: gravel group. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Hightailers Tuesday Gravel group ride

Weeknight gravel ride on the farm roads east of Memphis. Twenty-five to forty miles, no-drop, gravel bikes. Starts from a barbecue joint in Oakland. The same leader runs a longer Saturday gravel ride that moves around north Mississippi.
